proposed_widenings.name: grant_cunning_strike_option
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature is passive at acquisition time, but its actual mechanics are to unlock a new named option inside the existing Cunning Strike system. The current passive grants list has no atom for granting an attack-rider option with an embedded cost and rider text.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the following Cunning Strike option.

proposed_widenings.name: conditional_hide_invisibility_retention
proposed_widenings.justification: The option does not apply a fresh condition. It conditionally suppresses the normal attack-based break of the Hide action's Invisible condition, then checks a post-attack end-of-turn board state predicate based on cover. The current surface has early-end triggers on durations, but no way to override another source's early-end rule with a deferred cover-gated exception.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you have the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

notes: No honest authored UnitRecord fits without widening. I did not create content/rogue_supreme_sneak_l9.dhall or derived JSON/trace because any current encoding would misrepresent either the Cunning Strike option grant or the Hide-based invisibility retention rider.
